notes.decision: Translated as '1468' — the standard Manichaean number for the duration of the cosmic conflagration. ⲙⲛⲧ- prefix on ⲁϥⲧⲉ̄ here functions numerically: the Great Fire burns for 1,468 years. This is the canonical Manichaean figure preserved in multiple sources.
Rendered 'the release' = ⲧⲟⲓⲛⲃⲱⲗ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'the dissolution' from accumulated vocabulary. ⲃⲓⲛ-/ⲟⲓⲛ- variants both form action-nouns from ⲃⲱⲗ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ. Eschatological cosmic-dissolution term.

Following accumulated vocabulary entry: 'prison/fastness' or possibly = ⲧⲍⲱⲛⲏ (Greek ζώνη, 'zone/girdle') — fitting the Manichaean motif of the cosmos as zodiacal prison. Left as 'prison/zone' to preserve ambiguity.
Variant of ⲍⲱⲣⲁⲫⲉ 'depict, paint' (already in vocabulary). The Last Extraction (ⲡⲁⲛⲁⲣⲉⲓⲁⲥ ⲛ̄ϩⲁⲉ) is the eschatological Image — the Andrias-Statue produced by 'painting' the gathered light.
Likely = ⲥⲉⲡⲉ 'remainder, residue.' The Light is separated 'out from the residue' of all things — i.e., from the residual matter. Alternative reading 'fire' (ⲥⲉⲧⲉ) less likely given context.

ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁ tentatively read as 'their measure/portion' (ⲟⲩⲱⲣⲁ) paired with ⲱⲭⲛⲉ 'fail, cease' (accumulated vocab). Alternative: ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛ 'their name' shall fail. Either fits the eschatological-decline context.
Verb form unidentified. Possibly relates to ⲕⲓⲙ 'move' (ⲁⲥ-ⲕⲓⲙ-ⲧⲥ̄ 'she moved/disturbed it') or to ⲕⲱⲙⲧ̄ 'gather' (accumulated vocab). Left untranslated and flagged.
